name: C++
short_description: Modern C++ with OOP, templates, RAII, STL containers, and move semantics.
description: Comprehensive C++ curriculum focusing on object-oriented programming, standard template library (STL), memory management, and modern C++ features.

courses.title: C++ Programming
courses.description: Modern C++ from procedural core to templates, STL, and object-oriented abstractions.

modules.title: Fundamentals
modules.description: C++ streams, namespaces, auto typing, and modern enhancements.

topics.title: C++ Modern Syntax & Streams
topics.summary: iostream, namespaces, references, and type inference.

modules.title: Functions
modules.description: Function overloading, default arguments, inline functions, and pass by reference.

topics.title: Overloading & Pass-By-Reference
topics.summary: Const references, function name mangling, and inline execution.

modules.title: Arrays & Strings
modules.description: std::vector, std::array, and std::string modern wrappers.

topics.title: Standard Containers (vector & string)
topics.summary: Dynamic array growth, capacity vs size, and string methods.

modules.title: Pointers & References
modules.description: Lvalue/rvalue references, smart pointers (unique_ptr, shared_ptr), and RAII.

topics.title: Smart Pointers & RAII Paradigm
topics.summary: std::unique_ptr, std::shared_ptr, and automatic destructor cleanup.

modules.title: Classes & Objects
modules.description: Constructors, destructors, rule of three/five, and access specifiers.

topics.title: Class Encapsulation & Constructors
topics.summary: Initialization lists, copy constructors, and operator overloading.

topics.title: Copy Control, Move Semantics & the Rule of Five
topics.summary: Destructors, copy and move operations, and when to write them.

topics.title: Operator Overloading
topics.summary: Giving user-defined types natural syntax for arithmetic, comparison, and streaming.

modules.title: Inheritance
modules.description: Public/protected/private inheritance, constructor chaining, and multiple inheritance.

topics.title: Inheritance Models & Base Classes
topics.summary: Base-derived class relationships and diamond problem resolution.

modules.title: Polymorphism
modules.description: Virtual functions, vtable mechanics, abstract classes, and pure virtual interfaces.

topics.title: Virtual Functions & VTable Dispatch
topics.summary: Runtime dynamic dispatch and abstract interfaces.

modules.title: Templates
modules.description: Function and class templates, type traits, and compile-time specialization.

topics.title: Generic Programming with Templates
topics.summary: Template instantiation, template parameters, and generic algorithms.

modules.title: STL
modules.description: Standard Template Library containers, iterators, and <algorithm> utilities.

topics.title: STL Containers & Iterators
topics.summary: Map, set, unordered_map, priority_queue, and std::sort.

topics.title: STL Algorithms & Lambda Expressions
topics.summary: sort, find_if, transform, accumulate, and lambdas with captures.

modules.title: Exception Handling
modules.description: Reporting and recovering from errors without leaking resources.

topics.title: Exceptions & Exception Safety
topics.summary: throw, try, catch, standard exceptions, and the basic and strong guarantees.

modules.title: File Handling
modules.description: fstream, ifstream, and ofstream stream operations.

topics.title: Modern File Streams
topics.summary: RAII file opening, formatted text reading, and binary streams.
